method: The unchanged WorldServer (mt) is allocated without a constructor with real pendingTickListEntriesHashSet / TreeSet / ThisTick and a WorldInfo total time. read: the unchanged private AnvilChunkLoader reader calls the unchanged WorldServer.func_147446_b for every TileTicks entry of each loaded chunk in turn; the TreeSet is dumped in iteration order as [block id, x, y, z, scheduledTime - totalTime, priority]. write: entries are added to the real sets (and to ThisTick), then the unchanged writer saves one chunk through the unchanged getPendingBlockUpdates (2-block border box); the saved list is dumped in order as [i, x, y, z, t, p]. tick: the unchanged WorldServer.tickUpdates (mt.a(boolean)) runs once on entries at y 300 (the unchanged checkChunksExist fails first, so every taken entry is removed without ticking) and the remaining TreeSet shows the 1000-entry cap and the removal order. sequence: the same tickUpdates called on six consecutive world times with 2600 and 3300 mixed-kind entries, so the cap of 1000 spills from call to call; the remaining TreeSet after each call is dumped. Block ticking and live-world integration are not exercised.
